name: ZOMVIRUS – Zombie Survival Action
summary:
ZOMVIRUS is a VR Zombie Survival Action Shooter with Co-op, built for players who want the pressure of staying alive together. Team up with a friend and face the outbreak side-by-side — revive each other, cover angles, call targets, and survive waves that would shred solo players. When your partner reloads late or panics, you either clutch the moment or you both go down hard.
